title: 1 Kings Bible Quiz - Chapter 18
description: Ten questions on 1 Kings 18: Obadiah and the hidden prophets, Elijah against the prophets of Baal on Mount Carmel, and the end of the drought.

questions.text: What had Obadiah done when Jezebel cut off Yahweh's prophets?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 18:4 says Obadiah took one hundred prophets, hid them by fifty in a cave, and fed them with bread and water.

answers.text: Hid one hundred prophets by fifty in a cave
Warned Elijah to flee to Sidon
Took them across the Jordan
Hid them in the king's own house

questions.text: Why did Ahab send Obadiah through the land to the springs and brooks?
questions.explanation: In 1 Kings 18:5 Ahab says, "Perhaps we may find grass and save the horses and mules alive."

answers.text: To count the flocks and herds
To dig new wells for the people
To find grass to save the horses and mules
To gather the prophets of Baal

questions.text: What did Ahab call Elijah when he saw him?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 18:17 says that when Ahab saw Elijah, he said, "Is that you, you troubler of Israel?"

answers.text: "My lord the prophet"
"You troubler of Israel"
"You man of God"
"My enemy"

questions.text: To which mountain did Elijah tell Ahab to gather all Israel and the prophets?
questions.explanation: In 1 Kings 18:19 Elijah tells Ahab to gather all Israel to Mount Carmel, with the prophets of Baal and of the Asherah.

answers.text: Mount Horeb
Mount Zion
Mount Gerizim
Mount Carmel

questions.text: How did the people respond when Elijah asked how long they would waver between two sides?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 18:21 says that after Elijah's question, the people didn't say a word.

answers.text: They shouted, "Yahweh is God!"
They didn't say a word
They chose to follow Baal
They asked for a sign

questions.text: How would they know which one was God?
questions.explanation: In 1 Kings 18:24 Elijah says, "The God who answers by fire, let him be God."

answers.text: The God who answers by fire
The God who sends rain first
The God whose prophets are the most
The God who speaks from heaven

questions.text: While mocking the prophets of Baal, what did Elijah suggest Baal might be doing?
questions.explanation: In 1 Kings 18:27 Elijah mocks them, saying Baal may be deep in thought, gone somewhere, on a journey, or asleep and needing to be awakened.

answers.text: Angry with them for their sins
Waiting for a bigger sacrifice
Afraid of the God of Israel
Sleeping and needing to be awakened

questions.text: Why did Elijah take twelve stones to build the altar?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 18:31 says Elijah took twelve stones, according to the number of the tribes of the sons of Jacob.

answers.text: For the twelve months of the year
For the twelve prophets left in Israel
For the number of the tribes of the sons of Jacob
For the twelve days of the feast

questions.text: What happened to the water in the trench when Yahweh's fire fell?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 18:38 says Yahweh's fire consumed the burnt offering, the wood, the stones, and the dust, and licked up the water that was in the trench.

answers.text: It turned into blood
The fire licked it up
It overflowed the altar
It stayed and put out the fire

questions.text: On the seventh time, what did Elijah's servant see rising out of the sea?
questions.explanation: In 1 Kings 18:44 the servant says, "Behold, a small cloud, like a man's hand, is rising out of the sea."

answers.text: A great storm with lightning
A flock of birds flying low
A pillar of fire and smoke
A small cloud like a man's hand
